newsitem.title: PERU: Another hostage released from Peru embassy siege.
newsitem.headline: Another hostage released from Peru embassy siege.

text.p: Marxist rebels set another hostage free on Tuesday evening from the Japanese embassy residence in Lima.
The Red Cross named the released hostage as Uruguayan ambassador Tabare Bocalandro Yapeyu.
"Just to inform you of the freeing of one person, that of the ambassador of Uruguay," chief Red Cross negotiator Michel Minnig told reporters outside the residence.
Minnig said 105 hostages remained inside the residence.

He did not go into details about why the envoy had been set free but local television said Uruguay had apparently set free two members of the same Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrilla movement as the hostage-takers earlier in the day.
Peru had been seeking the extradition of the two Peruvians, a man and a woman, but a Uruguayan court earlier on Tuesday denied the extradition request and ordered their release, media reports said.
This could not immediately be confirmed.
